evidence.text: Simplified form of 見; a man 儿 with the eye 目 emphasized
Simplified form of 見.  Pictograph of a person (卩) using their eye (目) to see (見).
Simplified form of 見 from cursive script.
A man 儿 with the eye 目 emphasized
Pictograph of a person (卩) using their eye (目) to see (見).
視也。从儿从目。凡見之屬皆从見。

Ideogrammic compound (會意 /会意) - 目 (“eye”) + 卩 (“kneeling person”) – a kneeling human figure with a large eye for a head. Similar but unrelated to 艮. See also 夏 and 監.
From Proto-Sino-Tibetan *ken.
